title: A napkin on the step
logline: Last Bell, after: the school steps empty at 3:20, the kids gone to the beach, and on the third step a napkin with a drawing on it, left. The page doesn't turn it over.

panels.composition: The school's front steps empty after the bell, the doors shut, and on the third step a paper napkin with ink on its visible corner, weighted by a pebble, the road to the beach empty beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, empty school steps after the last bell with a paper napkin bearing a corner of an ink drawing weighted by a pebble on the third step, an empty road toward a beach beyond, no words
image.notes: Whose: reserved. The page doesn't turn it over.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A napkin, left. Not turned over.
